questionText: What was "Raiyatwari" system?

options.text: The tenants could keep two-third of the agricultural produce.
The cultivators paid agricultural tax directly to the British government.
Buying land in the name of others after land ceiling.

solution.quick: In the Raiyatwari system, the colonial state settled land revenue directly with the cultivators (raiyats).
